project_type: Node.js/TypeScript Express backend with Supabase for persistence and authentication
build_system: TypeScript compiler (tsc) with ts-node-dev for development
verification_instructions: Run `npm run typecheck` from backend/ directory to verify TypeScript compilation without errors. Manual testing requires Supabase credentials in .env file.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ directory contains compiled JavaScript from TypeScript source. Generated by `npm run build`. Not checked into git.
environment_constraints: ABDM integration requires sandbox credentials (ABDM_CLIENT_ID, ABDM_CLIENT_SECRET, ABDM_HIP_ID, ABDM_HIU_ID, ABDM_CALLBACK_BASE_URL) to be functional. Development can proceed without them but runtime testing requires real credentials from ABDM sandbox registration.
contribution_requirements: Rule 20 (100-line hard limit per file), Rule 7 (business logic in services only), Rule 15 (per-request Supabase client, admin client only in migrations/callback handlers), Rule 19 (one responsibility per file), Rule 21 (zero duplication tolerance)
key_patterns: Services follow milestone-based extraction (AbdmM1Service, AbdmM2Service, AbdmM3Service for M1/M2/M3 workflows). Route handlers delegate to workflow services (AbdmWorkflowService). Callback handlers in abdmCallbacks.handlers.ts delegate to AbdmCallbackService. All ABDM HTTP calls go through milestone services which use AbdmAuth for token management. Types split between abdm.types.ts (domain models) and abdmCallback.types.ts (callback payloads).
directory_structure: backend/src/services/abdm/ contains milestone-specific services (M1=ABHA verification, M2=care context linking, M3=consent and health info fetch). AbdmAuth.ts handles gateway authentication. backend/src/routes/ contains abdm.ts (staff-facing, requires auth) and abdmCallbacks.ts (inbound gateway callbacks, public routes with NO auth currently). backend/src/types/ contains abdm.types.ts and abdmCallback.types.ts for type definitions. backend/migrations/ contains schema (0014) and permission seed (0015).
